notes: The Richmond district, 1975 sheet p05 (page as scanned, lettering sideways): Cabrillo St (x 1915-1944), Balboa St (x 2169-2197) and Anza St (x 2421-2451) run down the page; Thirty-second Ave (y 3314-3338), the unnamed Thirty-first Ave (y 3428-3451, west of Balboa only), Thirtieth (y 3541-3566), Twenty-ninth, Twenty-eighth, 27th, Twenty-sixth and Twenty-fifth run across it. Box as given (1760, 3250, 860, 940), not moved. Every printed block is a polygon (33); everything else in the box is street. No open polygons: the whole box is mapped ground with no land lacking an outline of its own. How the sides were placed: a scratch script took each block's paper from the scan (ink darker than 138), walked out from the paper across the block's own thin line (3 px; where a heavy border lies beside it the push is the thin-line width, so the side stays on the thin line's outer edge) and fitted a straight side through the outermost ink px; each side was then nudged by 1-2 px at either end where that put more of the line inside and less of it outside, and every block was checked by eye on 4x overlays and on the labels picture. Sides sit within about 1 px of the thin line's outer edge (the lines are ragged and step by a px in places). Corrected by hand: the P block's Thirtieth side steps from y 3540 to 3539 at x 2465-2466. Heavy zoning borders: those running through blocks (x 1876-1880 in the blocks west of Cabrillo; x 1979-1983 and 2131-2135 between Cabrillo and Balboa; x 2232-2240 and 2378-2385 between Balboa and Anza; the L at (1760-1880, 4065-4070)-(1873-1877, 4010-4070); the steps at (2100-2135, 3940-3955), (2127-2140, 3812-3845) and the like; y 4178-4185 across the bottom row) do not split them: one polygon per block. Those in streets are street: along Thirty-second Ave (y 3322-3335, x 1876-2620), down Balboa (x 2181-2186, y 3325-3555), along Thirtieth (y 3547-3553, x 2186-2620), down Anza in the top row (x 2432-2438, y 3250-3330), down Cabrillo (x 1928-1932, y 4010-4182) and across Twenty-sixth (y 4005-4015, x 1880-1932), across Balboa at y 3255, and every short crossing of a street. Judgment calls (please rule): 1. The large block lettered P (x 2197-2620, y 3338-3540) is one block: it covers the ground where Thirty-first Ave and Anza St would run east of Balboa, and no street is printed there. 2. The small R-1-D district in its north-west corner (x 2197-2235, y 3338-3400), closed by a heavy border on its east and south sides, has no thin outline of its own (the block's thin line runs straight past it at x 2197-2199 and y 3338-3340), so it is kept in the P block. The letters R-1-D straddle that thin line; the parts in Balboa St (x 2190-2196) are street. 3. The street names THIRTY-SECOND (x 2455-2620, y 3290-3307) and THIRTIETH (x 2465-2600, y 3510-3530) are printed INSIDE the closed outlines of the blocks just above those avenues, so they are kept in the blocks; the other avenue names (TWENTY-NINTH ... TWENTY-FIFTH, 27TH) and CABRILLO, BALBOA, ANZA, ST. are printed in the street paper and are street. 4. Zoning letters lying across a street and a block (R-3 at x 1925-1965 and x 2180-2215, y 3850-3945; R-4 at x 1780-1830, y 4075-4170) are ignored: the sides follow the thin lines under them. 5. No dead-end alleys or two-line alleys in the box. Blocks cut by the box's sides end on the box edge (x 1760 and 2620, y 3250 and 4190).
